beats.say: Two actors: Walter Koenig became Chekov.
He was one of only two to audition for the role.
Koenig started as Chekov in the second season of Star Trek.
His casting was swift, almost immediate after the audition.
This quick choice made him a beloved character in sci-fi history.
How many auditions did your favourite TV roles need?
